Sub 'WriteData'

For each trnscardapio order carDapCodigo when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carDapCodigo) when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True order carDapDescricao when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carDapDescricao) when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True order carDapNutricionista when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carDapNutricionista) when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True order carDapMesAno when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carDapMesAno) when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True order carDapStatus when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carDapStatus) when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True order carDapLiberarAcesso when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carDapLiberarAcesso) when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True

// Write cell values &CellRow += 1
Do 'BeforeWriteLine' &VisibleColumnCount = 0 For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True Do Case Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'carDapCodigo' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = carDapCodigo Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'carDapDescricao' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(carDapDescricao) Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'carDapNutricionista' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(usuNome) Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'carDapMesAno' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = carDapMesAno Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'carDapStatus' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = carDapStatus.EnumerationDescription() Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'carDapLiberarAcesso' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = '' do Case Case carDapLiberarAcesso.ToString().Trim() = "N" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Não"
Case carDapLiberarAcesso.ToString().Trim() = "A" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Liberar Pelo Atendimento"
Case carDapLiberarAcesso.ToString().Trim() = "L" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Liberar"
EndCase EndCase &VisibleColumnCount += 1 EndIf EndFor
Do 'AfterWriteLine'
Endfor
